name: sales-enablement
description: Sales coaching and practice for sellers. Coach a sales call with quotes from the call; quiz reps on your own pricing or product notes; rehearse with a practice buyer who reveals facts only when asked the right question; plan a demo where each segment answers a need the buyer named; find buyer questions your team answers differently, without proof or not at all; and work out how long a new seller needs before selling alone, against your coaching hours. Built from your material, plus a few dated, cited public facts used only when they change the answer; nothing invented except clearly labelled fictional role-play details. Scores are practice feedback, not a basis for hiring, pay or dismissal, and sellers are never ranked.
